humanActions.title: ADMIN POWERSHELL NEEDED: every Shopkeeper scheduled task is LogonType=Interactive and silently no-ops when the machine is locked
humanActions.detail:
ROOT CAUSE of the 2026-08-21 live price mismatch, and of the 2026-08-14 launch miss.

All 7 Shopkeeper-* tasks have Principal.LogonType = Interactive, so the action only runs with an active console session. Locked/logged-out at trigger time = Task Scheduler records the task as run, returns LastTaskResult=1, and the process NEVER LAUNCHES. No log file, no output, no alert. rc=1-with-no-log is indistinguishable from a clean run unless someone looks.

Already cost two incidents:
  Shopkeeper-SWSLaunch-20260814     8/14 00:00 rc=1   promo launch never fired
  Shopkeeper-SWSTeardown-20260821   8/21 00:05 rc=1
  Shopkeeper-SWSTeardown-SafetyNet2 8/21 01:30 rc=1
  Shopkeeper-SWSTeardown-SafetyNet  8/21 03:00 rc=1
The three teardown attempts shared the single root cause they were meant to insure against, so 264 variants advertised an 18% discount the cart refused for ~9h. Retrying the same principal N times is ONE point of failure, not N.

FIX (needs elevation -- the agent tried and got 'Access is denied'; S4U registration is admin-only). In an ADMIN PowerShell:
  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\JustinAdler\clawd-shopkeeper\Automations\fix_task_logontype_s4u.ps1
  (add -WhatIf first to preview; it re-reads each task to verify and refuses if not elevated)

S4U = 'run whether user is logged on or not', needs NO stored password.

THEN VERIFY UNATTENDED -- flipping the flag is not proof: lock the machine, fire a task, confirm rc=0 AND that the script's own log file exists. The missing log is the real signal.

humanActions.title: Price list has not been regenerated since April - True Gross and free-item value are running on a 2-day April sample
humanActions.detail:
prices_2026-05.json through prices_2026-09.json are BYTE-IDENTICAL (3,654 bytes, same 165 SKUs, same prices, verified by hash). No Shopify price change has entered the price_list table since 2026-05-01.

WORSE: the snapshot they all copy is itself thin. prices_2026-04.json was generated on 2026-04-03 from only 2 days of April orders and captured 165 SKUs, against 264 in March. So five months of True Gross rest on a 2-day sample that was already missing ~100 SKUs.

MECHANISM (generate_price_list.py:259 ensure_current_month):
  - On the 1st of the month daily_run.py runs at 07:00. now.day < 5 is true, so it takes the     'fallback' branch and copies the PREVIOUS month's file verbatim.
  - On every later day the file already exists, so the first branch returns     '[OK] price list exists' and generate_month() (the real Shopify GraphQL fetch) never runs.
The two branches close the loop on each other, so it can never self-correct. Tonight's log line 37 reads '[OK] 2026-09 price list exists (165 SKUs in DB)' - a healthy-looking OK for a file that is a 4-month-old copy.

MEASURED DAMAGE (2026-09-08):
  - 86 SKUs that sold in September have no 2026-09 price row: 1,062 of 4,537 DTC units     (23.4%) carry no MSRP.
  - Free-item value has collapsed. calc_daily_shopify.dtc_free_item_value ran $10.8k-$13.0k/mo     Jan-Apr, then $1,113 (May), $515 (Jul), $262 (Aug). Free UNIT counts did not fall     (2,724 in Aug), so this is a valuation failure, not a promo change - Aug works out to     $0.10 per free unit.
  - Cause is direct: 2,411 of Aug's 2,724 free units are SKU 50060, which has NO row in     price_list for 2026-08, so it is valued at $0.
  - Aggregate dtc_gross is less damaged (gross/revenue holds ~1.12), so this does NOT show up     on the headline MTD/YTD tiles. The discounts dashboard's free-item figure is the surface     that is currently wrong.

FIX: regenerate the real thing for each affected month, e.g.
  python generate_price_list.py 2026 5   (then 6, 7, 8, 9 - positional YEAR MONTH,
  verified in generate_price_list.py:305; it overwrites the monthly file and reloads the DB)
then re-run: python transform_daily.py 2026-05-01 2026-09-08 and python transform_sku.py 2026-05-01 2026-09-08.
AND fix ensure_current_month so a carried-forward file is marked provisional and regenerated once the month has >=5 days of orders - otherwise this silently re-freezes next month.
